annotation.evidence_span: SHOULD send a maximum-sized segment whenever possible
annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation always attempts to send the largest possible segment, even if the application hasn't provided enough data to fill it.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation prioritizes sending maximum-sized segments, but will send smaller segments if that's all the application provides at a given time.
annotation.justification: The use of 'whenever possible' is vague. It's unclear if the implementation is *required* to buffer data to create a maximum-sized segment, or if it only sends maximum-sized segments when the application provides enough data to fill one. This leads to two reasonable interpretations of how the implementation should behave.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the 'maximum-sized segment' refers to the maximum segment size (MSS) or the maximum size allowed by the receive window. It also doesn't clarify if the implementation should buffer data to achieve a maximum-sized segment, or simply send what it has.
